notes.title: Update On 9/25/25
notes.content: NEW UPDATE! We have added the beach Cart where you can sell food items and hire employees to run your cart. We also have done to many to list bug fixes if you notice some please let us know thanks!

notes.title: 2025 New Year Update
notes.content:
Map has been expanded with new locations!

Rental home now can be furnished to increase your Happiness
Ok store and furniture store has new deliveries

Next to come will be:
buy and run the beach food cart
rent a warehouse to start storing goods
rent land and have different crops and grow crops in green houses

notes.title: Aug. Small Update
notes.content:
Here are the fixes we have done:
Mouse issues when saving and returning has been fixed.

The Rentable house was not saving when you quit the game. (you must start over by claiming Bankruptcy to clear any rental agreements that you may acquired by renting the house).

Fixed the dollar signs.

Fuel price will now change with the economy.

Steam Achievements now have been added and are working.

Added the keys you use to play the game to the help info.

Cell Phone has been added by pushing (P) right now there is not much use but, there will be additions to this feature that will allow you to purchase buildings and invest in the stock market of other players also View players contracts that other players post.

We also have expanded map and getting ready to build on to the city and create new areas such as mining and forest production.
